newsitem.title: USA: Western Europe set to turn dry again this week-WSC.
newsitem.headline: Western Europe set to turn dry again this week-WSC.

text.p: Light to locally moderate rain fell in the drought-plagued areas of western Europe in the past couple of days, though it looks dry again for much of this coming week, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
WSC's latest three-to-five day forecast said the British Isles would be dry from Wednesday to Friday, with mild temperatures.
Elsewhere in western Europe, any showers lingering in the east early in the period would end and the weather would turn dry and seasonable in the east of the region, and warmer to the west.
Germany and central Europe would see a chance of showers, with cool conditions in the east but dry and seasonable weather in the west.
Mediterranean Europe would be wet and cool from Italy through to Greece, but generally dry and milder in western areas from Wednesday to Friday, WSC said.
